purpose: extend ODSP to periodic scalar ecological states without imposing an artificial boundary at the period origin
primary_target: p(t|X) for one circular state t with an explicitly declared period

reference_learner.name: harmonic-regression von Mises state model
reference_learner.conditional_direction: weighted linear regressions of cos(theta) and sin(theta), followed by circular residual offset calibration
reference_learner.conditional_concentration: von Mises concentration estimated from weighted training residual resultant length
reference_learner.claim: transparent reference circular-density learner, not a universal activity-time distribution

secondary_diagnostics: circular mean absolute error and improvement over marginal circular mean
training-residual circular prediction arc and held-out empirical coverage

external_learner_interface.minimum_requirement: held-out conditional and training-marginal log density at every realized circular state

known_truth_benchmark.shift_definition: held-out mean circular state is displaced by half a period relative to training organization
obligations: all stable replicates have positive held-out log-density gain
all shifted replicates have negative held-out log-density gain
absolute mean null gain is below 0.02
gain is invariant to a common circular phase-origin shift to absolute error <= 1e-10
gain is invariant to equivalent period-unit conversion from 24 hours to 1440 minutes to absolute error <= 1e-10
reference 90% residual prediction-arc coverage lies between 0.87 and 0.93 under stable same-process data

out_of_scope: automatic correction of camera or observation detection bias
